*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +2 and ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Damage reduction rate 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
- "Crossover" or "Vegeta's Family" Category allies' Ki +2 and
ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Per "Crossover" or "Vegeta's Family" Category ally on the team
(depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK & DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 500%)
- Chance of performing a critical hit & chance of evading enemy's
attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 50%)
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional Super Attack
*When receiving an attack with 12 or more Ki*
- DEF 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
*With an INT or PHY Ki Sphere obtained*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 20%{passiveImg:up_g} as the 2nd attacker
in a turn
- Performs a critical hit and launches an additional Super Attack
as the 3rd attacker in a turn
*With a STR, AGL or TEQ Ki Sphere obtained*
- All allies' Ki +2 and DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g} for 2 turns and guards all attacks
as the 2nd attacker in a turn
- All allies' ATK 40%{passiveImg:up_g} and chance of performing a critical hit 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
for 3 turns as the 3rd attacker in a turn
